topik: WebSocket Communication through the ws.irisiotlab.com Gateway
tagline: An ESP32 sends sensor data to a Python server through the ws.irisiotlab.com gateway.
ringkasan: An ESP32 reads a DHT22 sensor and sends its reading to a WebSocket server running on a PC Server and reached through ws.irisiotlab.com, so the ESP32 only needs Wi-Fi with Internet access.
The server tells each group's board apart by its connection path, so several groups can share one server without disturbing each other.

toolchain.label: Server on the PC Server
toolchain.alat: Python (CPython), via a text editor and a virtual environment

perangkat.jumlah: 1x, as the server, reached through ws.irisiotlab.com

catatan: The PC Server needs no additional circuit at all. The WebSocket server runs entirely in software, and is reached through ws.irisiotlab.com, so the ESP32 only needs to be on a Wi-Fi network with Internet access.
A DHT22 must not be read more often than once every 2 seconds. A tighter interval returns NAN.

persiapan: Installing the DHT sensor library and Adafruit Unified Sensor libraries through the Arduino IDE Library Manager
Installing the WebSockets library by Markus Sattler through the Arduino IDE Library Manager
Preparing a websockets virtual environment on the PC Server (python3 -m venv, then pip install "websockets>=13")
Noting the server address ws.irisiotlab.com and connecting the ESP32 to Wi-Fi with Internet access
Using your own group's path for WS_PATH
Matching the path across both program files, and using WS_PORT 80 (the gateway port) on the ESP32
